uncaught_mutation.mutation: Publish pkg.\u0441ore@1.0.0 (Cyrillic 'es') next to pkg.core@1.0.0 with a valid signature and matching hash of its own payload.
uncaught_mutation.why_uncaught: Every named test uses exact string equality on package_id. The fixture index has no homoglyph-normalization or confusable-id check, so the suite still greens while a human operator installs the lookalike.
